svg.title: Leave | Self-service request, segregated decision and notification

g.text: Leave | Self-service request, segregated decision and notification
Check ownership; set read_at once; COMMIT
Bars indicate request/query execution, not asynchronous push delivery.
Dashed responses return control to the initiating caller.
The normal linked-profile path is shown; missing records yield 404.
Employee UI exists; decision UI does not.
Notifications are fetched, not email/SMS/push messages.
No timer-driven notification polling is configured in the current UI.
Concurrent decision serialization is a separate acceptance test.
